text:
irene (eng-sec): heads-up — audit alert: service account attrs-service-prod suddenly has S3 List access on bucket customer-data-prod. spike @ 13:42 UTC. did anyone touch RBAC yesterday?
aj (infra): that was me, merged rbac-refactor PR #4392 at ~00:15 UTC. I scoped a new role but might have reused an existing managed policy. digging now.
lucas (sre): on it. pulling the binding diff. @deploy-bot can you dump the current iam bindings for attrs-service-prod?
deploy-bot: iam-bindings for service/attrs-service-prod -> policies: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/attrs-service-base, attached inline: {"S3Access":"s3:ListBucket,s3:GetObject"} (source: aws_iam_policy_attachment/attrs-service)
maya (platform): whoa, GetObject in an inline policy? that sounds like an accidental copy from analytics team. aj, did you copy an existing policy blob?
aj (infra): i copied attrs-service-base from infra/policies/common.tf because i wanted the logging bits. i thought it was read-only meta, not bucket-level access. my bad.
irene (eng-sec): ok immediate mitigation: block access to customer-data-prod for that role and rotate creds if any long-lived. lucas can you confirm what calls happened (CloudTrail/audit)?
lucas (sre): checking CloudTrail now — found 12 s3:ListBucket calls between 13:41–13:44 from arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/attrs-service-prod. no s3:GetObject calls logged so far. looks like listing only.
maya (platform): still want to revoke quickly. aj, can you push a deny policy to short-circuit? quick ACL:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::customer-data-prod/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```
aj (infra): applying now via terraform quick patch: `tf apply -target=aws_iam_policy.customer_data_deny` — will report back.
deploy-bot: terraform plan OK, apply in progress (plan id: plan-9843)
aj (infra): applied. deny policy attached. also removed s3:GetObject from inline policy and pushed a new commit to revert that section (PR #4401).
lucas (sre): CloudTrail shows denied GetObject attempts at 13:47 immediately after deny attached (2 denied). ListBucket still logged but no successful GetObject.
irene (eng-sec): good. next steps: 1) rotate any long-lived keys for attrs-service-prod (if present) 2) audit other roles that consumed attrs-service-base 3) postmortem + test to prevent copying full policy blobs. aj, please rotate and confirm. maya, can you add a CI policy lint rule to fail on wildcard S3 resources?
aj (infra): rotating instance profile keys now, patching kube controllers to pick up new creds. will confirm when pods restart.
maya (platform): adding lint rule: deny attached policies that include s3:* or unscoped resource ARNs. PR incoming.
irene (eng-sec): filing incident ticket and adding minimal blameless notes. include CloudTrail snippet and PR links. also follow up with analytics owner about the copied blob.
aj (infra): pods restarted, new creds in place. no more assumed-role traffic with old session id.
lucas (sre): final check: 0 successful GetObject since mitigation; ListBucket calls dropped to background. looks contained.
irene (eng-sec): thanks team. please include the mitigation timeline in the incident ticket and tag security-review. we'll add an automation to alert on new roles gaining access to critical buckets.
audit-bot: audit-log: incident created #INC-2026-328; severity: high; tags: rbac, s3, quick-mitigation
irene (eng-sec): assigning postmortem to aj + maya. aim for preliminary notes in 24h.
